dispositions.reason: The repository file owns several persistence and migration contracts; its complete canonical owner and consumer closure remains required for any valid change.
Archive export has one cross-format compatibility contract, so a Documentation-only slice would omit valid Flow archive consumers.
Archive parsing and validation are shared compatibility behavior and retain their complete parent closure.
Project portability is an atomic import/export boundary whose complete current consumers remain required.
The installed Documentation contribution owns future Documentation composition while the global application controller remains unchanged by the resumed product.
The public runtime exposes the generic staging capability while project scoping, byte copying, generation identity, and pending-body lifecycle live in the independently tested durable staging seam.

The Schema model supplies document paths, property access, drafts, promotion rules, and parent resolution to library, property, rule, guided, source, and lifecycle code.
The source controller converts captured events into library drafts and property views through the shared public facade, and no exact source consumer slice exists.
